# gi.geospatial.substring_3d { #bedrock_ge.gi.geospatial.substring_3d }

```python
gi.geospatial.substring_3d(linestring, start_dist, end_dist)
```

Extract a substring of a 3D LineString using true 3D distances.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type       | Description                               | Default    |
|------------|------------|-------------------------------------------|------------|
| linestring | LineString | A 3D LineString geometry                  | _required_ |
| start_dist | float      | Start distance along the line in 3D space | _required_ |
| end_dist   | float      | End distance along the line in 3D space   | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                | Description                         |
|--------|---------------------|-------------------------------------|
|        | LineString \| Point | The extracted 3D LineString segment |
